change: Accordion caption priority by distance from the active tab
policy: Reveal minimum useful captions nearest the active tab first, then grow captions outward by distance. Equal-distance neighbors share growth. Preserve natural content widths, caps, compact icon targets and overflow scrolling.
coverage: Adjacent caption wins at either end
Equal-distance neighbors share space before distant tabs
A short distant caption cannot steal an adjacent captions budget
Selecting a different active tab transfers caption priority
Existing content sizing, short labels, pixel rounding, overflow visibility and drag reorder
scope: Android tab width allocation only; no added animation loops or transport changes
